newsitem.title: USA: Cincinnati Microwave in cash crunch.
newsitem.headline: Cincinnati Microwave in cash crunch.

text.p: Cincinnati Microwave Inc said on Tuesday that its cash shortage may force it to consider alliances, additional equity offerings, a merger or a bankruptcy filing.

The company has been unable to meet payment plans previously established with its vendors and many vendors are requiring it to pay in advance for production requirements, said Cincinnati Microwave, a maker of ultra-high frequency communications products.
Cincinnati Microwave said it has had increased downtime problems because of the situation with vendors.
The company continues to reduce its cost of business and, in mid-November, reducing its workforce by 70 percent since December 1995, Cincinnati Microwave said.
Cincinnati Microwave said it is at the maximum borrowing limit for its credit line and it has liquidated some of its inventories at or below cost.
The company said it may post a charge to reflect the carrying values of some assets based upon their estimated net realizable values.
